# Components

Every component that can be added to an entity (Inspector > Add Component, `comp add <Entity> <Component>` in automation, `AddComponent("Name")` from scripts). Field names are the keys used in scene files and by `GetComponentField` / `SetComponentField` in scripts; defaults are the values of a freshly added component.

158 components in 24 categories.

## AI & Navigation

### NavMesh Agent

Moves along the baked NavMesh to a destination: acceleration, braking, turning, links (jumps) and avoidance of other agents.

### Character Customizer

MetaHuman Creator-style customization of a skinned character: height, head size, body width, arm and leg length (bone scaling), skin tone, hair and eye colors. Skin materials switch to the Subsurface (skin) shading model, hair to Hair.

### Bone 2D

### Auto LOD

Generates simplified levels of detail for this model's meshes (quadric edge collapse) and switches them by screen size, like Unreal's Static Mesh LOD settings. LODs belong to the mesh asset: every object using the model shares them. r.ForceLOD forces a level for debugging.

| LOD3 Screen Size | `ScreenSize3` | Float | `0.06` |  |

### Vertex Paint

Per-object vertex colors painted in the viewport (Unreal Mesh Paint). PBR materials multiply albedo by the color; Shader Graph reads it with the Vertex Color node. Painted objects always draw their full-detail LOD.

| Data | `Data` | String |  |  |

### Virtual Geometry

Nanite-style virtualized geometry for this model: meshes become a cluster hierarchy (built in the background) and every frame only the clusters needed for ~1 pixel of error are drawn, so very dense meshes stay cheap at any distance.

## Scripting

### Signal Connections

Godot-style signal connections made in the editor. One per line: "signal -> TargetObject.Method" (optionally " oneshot"); use "self" as the target for this object. Scripts emit with SignalEmit(self, "signal", ...); the engine emits body_entered / body_exited (triggers), collided and pressed / value_changed (UI).

Type `SignalConnectionsComponent`; script name `SignalConnections`.

| Field | Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Connections | `Connections` | String |  |  |

### Spline Extrude

Builds a mesh along a spline: a tube (pipes, cables) or your own cross-section profile (roads, kerbs, barriers, rails) kept level with the world. Uses this entity's Mesh Renderer material; add a Mesh Collider to drive or walk on it.

Type `SplineExtrudeComponent`; script name `SplineExtrude`; requires `MeshRendererComponent`.

| Field | Key | Type | Default | Description |

| Sides | `Sides` | Int | `12` |  |
| Capped | `Capped` | Bool | `true` |  |
| Profile | `Profile` | Vec3List |  | Cross-section points: x = right, y = up (metres), z = texture coordinate across. The visible side is on the left of the point order (left to right for a road, clockwise for solid shapes). |
| UV Length | `UVLength` | Float | `4` | Metres per texture repeat along the spline (rounded to fit a closed spline). |
| Swap UV | `SwapUV` | Bool | `false` | Texture u runs along the spline and v across the profile (signs, barrier stripes). |

## Video

### Video Player

Plays Motion-JPEG AVI, GIF or an image folder (other formats are converted once with ffmpeg if it is installed) onto a mesh, a Raw Image, a Sprite or the camera background.

Type `VideoPlayerComponent`; script name `VideoPlayer`.

| Field | Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Source | `Source` | Asset |  |  |
| Play On Awake | `PlayOnAwake` | Bool | `true` |  |
| Loop | `Loop` | Bool | `true` |  |
| Playback Speed | `PlaybackSpeed` | Float | `1` |  |
| Render Mode | `RenderMode` | Enum | `Material Override` | Options: Material Override, Camera Far Plane, Camera Near Plane, Raw Image, Sprite Renderer, API Only. |
| Target | `Target` | EntityRef | `0` | Object that shows the video (empty = this object). |
| Emissive | `Emissive` | Bool | `true` |  |
| Alpha | `CameraAlpha` | Float | `1` |  |
| _Audio_: Audio Output | `AudioOutput` | Enum | `Direct` | Options: None, Direct. |
| Volume | `Volume` | Float | `1` |  |
| Image Sequence FPS | `ImageSequenceFrameRate` | Float | `24` |  |
| Playing | `IsPlaying` | Bool | `false` |  |
| Time | `Time` | Float | `0` |  |
| Length | `Length` | Float | `0` |  |
| Frame | `Frame` | Int | `-1` |  |
| Status | `Status` | String |  |  |

## World

### Level Streaming Volume

Loads a scene additively when an activator (objects with the tag, or the main camera) enters the box and unloads it after leaving (Unreal level streaming).

Type `LevelStreamingVolumeComponent`; script name `LevelStreamingVolume`.

| Field | Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Level | `Level` | Asset |  |  |
| Size | `Size` | Vec3 | `20 10 20` |  |
| Activator Tag | `ActivatorTag` | String | `Player` | Game tag of the objects that stream the level in (empty = main camera) |
| Unload When Outside | `UnloadWhenOutside` | Bool | `true` |  |
| Unload Delay | `UnloadDelay` | Float | `1` |  |
| Level Offset | `Offset` | Vec3 | `0 0 0` |  |
| Inside | `Inside` | Bool | `false` |  |
| Loaded | `Loaded` | Bool | `false` |  |

### Streamed Level

Root of a level loaded additively (LevelLoadAdditive / Level Streaming Volume). Deleting this object unloads the level.

Type `StreamedLevelComponent`; script name `StreamedLevel`.

| Field | Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Source | `Source` | String |  |  |
| Level | `LevelName` | String |  |  |
